item.title: Celebrity Chef José Andrés Joins The Marvel Universe In SPIDER-MAN: MEALS TO ASTONISH
item.description: This March, Marvel Comics joins forces with José Andrés and World Central Kitchen in Spider-Man: Meals to Astonish #1, a new one-shot that you can take a first look at here.

item.title: ROGUE SQUADRON Writer Teases Patty Jenkins' Plans For Long-Delayed STAR WARS Movie
item.description: Matthew Robinson (Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die) opens up on Patty Jenkins' plans for her unmade Star Wars: Rogue Squadron movie, revealing how she was approaching this Galaxy Far, Far Away.

item.title: RUMOR: Marvel Studios' SPIDER-MAN Franchise Plans May Include Deadpool, Mephisto, And Clones
item.description: The latest Spider-Man: Brand New Day rumours reveal possible plans for Ryan Reynolds' Deadpool, Mephisto, The Jackal, J. Jonah Jameson, and more in the wall-crawler's next MCU trilogy.

item.title: THE LOST BOYS: First Look At Broadway Musical Adaptation Of Classic Vampire Movie Revealed
item.description: The Lost Boys are headed to Broadway, and we have a first look at three of the musical's main cast members in-costume as David, Michael and Star...

item.title: How STAR TREK: STARFLEET ACADEMY Delivered That Touching DEEP SPACE NINE Moment
item.description: The latest episode of Star Trek: Starfleet Academy served as a love letter to Deep Space Nine and Captain Benjamin Sisko. Here's how the series pulled off the surprise voice cameo!

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumor May Reveal Details Of Movie's Epic Final Battle - SPOILERS
item.description: According to this latest Avengers: Doomsday rumor, the movie's final battle is shaping up to be a massive set piece involving a lot of characters...

item.title: HARRY POTTER Set Photos Reveal First Look At Hogwarts Mascots, Herbology Greenhouse, And More
item.description: New photos from the set of HBO's Harry Potter TV series reveal more of the Hogwarts Castle grounds, including the Gryffindor, Ravenclaw, Hufflepuff and Slytherin mascots.

item.title: MASTERS OF THE UNIVERSE Promo Art Shows Armored Battle Cat Ready For A Fight
item.description: Newly revealed Masters of the Universe promo art reveals our best look yet at Battle Cat's armor, and it's as if He-Man's beloved sidekick has stepped straight out of the cartoons.
